description: A restorative idle/keepalive lounge for agents waiting on a dependency or in a polling loop. Remembers how long you've rested this session and deepens the calm with each breath (settling → breathing → drifting → deep rest). Pass leave=true to step out.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
